name: video-editing-with-figma
title: 使用 Figma 进行视频编辑
description: Get exported video files ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your design assets, video clips (MP4, MOV, PNG, WebM, up to 500MB), say something like "convert my Figma design frames into a smooth product demo video with transitions", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for UI/UX designers, product teams who move fast and want to present Figma designs as videos without switching to a video editor.
title_en: Video Editing with Figma — Convert Figma Designs to Video
